Messages.Author: Daneel
Messages.Body:
There are two questions on Abombwe that I'd like to get clarification on.

1. The discipline card (Abombwe). Can I ignore the first part of the
requirements (Laibon or vampire with Protean) if I place it in a
non-standard way (e.g. diablerie, Deviki Prasanta, Creation Rites, Bima,
etc.)?

2. It seems that Abombwe cards have a Reflex usage to cancel Frenzy. Also,
some of them are Frenzy cards. Is it possible to play an Abombwe Frenzy
card that targets the vampire playing it (like Devil Channel: Back at
superior) and then cancel it with the Reflex use of another Abombwe card
(like, Devil Channel: Back at reflex)?

--
Bye,

Daneel

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <1132125980.0...@o13g2000cwo.googlegroups.com>,


You can't cycle maneuvers like that because of explicit rules.

A minion cannot play two maneuvers in a row (which would
effectively cancel each other). [6.4.2]

There is no general principle, however, that you can't do things that
cancel each other out.
